## What's new

- **Pick several versions at once.** Under a video's versions, a Select button replaces the "Make 1080p my default quality" checkbox. Turn it on and each version gets a checkbox, so you can download 1080p and 720p and the audio in one go. Select All ticks every version in the Video list or the Audio list, whichever is showing. Next to the button, a line counts the video and audio you ticked and adds up their size. Your default quality still lives in Settings, in the Video tab.
- **Include every video on a page.** When a page has several videos, Include All next to the count includes all of them, and Include None takes them all out.
- **A name for each version.** When you download several versions of one video, each file name says its resolution, and the codec too when two share a resolution, such as "Talk (720p AV1).mp4".
- **Folders on file servers.** Send Dowlio a folder listing from a file server, such as an Apache "Index of" page or an h5ai index, and every video and audio file in it shows up under its own file name, with its size. Dowlio doesn't open subfolders.
- **More file types.** Dowlio now finds AVI, WMV, FLV, MPEG, 3GP, OGV, VOB, M2TS and RMVB video, and WMA, AIFF, MKA, APE, AC3 and DTS audio, on any page.

## Fixes

- A video named after its file, such as one from a direct link, no longer gets a file name ending in ".mp4.mp4".
